paragraphs: The F-Pace D200 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. It was fitted from the F-Pace's launch in 2016 through the current generation, making it one of the most common diesel options in the range. The AJ200D is a modular diesel design shared across Jaguar and Land Rover models of this era, and while it's a generally reliable unit, the Ingenium diesel family has a documented pattern of timing chain and injector seal wear over time. Knowing which engine you have matters because the components and wear patterns differ between the 2.0-litre diesel and other F-Pace engines — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D engines for every F-Pace D200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the F-Pace D200 from 2016 to the present (X761 generation). Known for timing chain stretch and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the F-Pace range spans multiple engine families across the same generation — including 2.0-litre and 3.0-litre diesels, petrol Ingenium units, and the SVR's supercharged V8 — fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts from one engine will work on another risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick.
